observations: Photos 0 and 1: a white industrial flatbed straight-stitch sewing machine head mounted on a white industrial table with a metal stand, thread stand, knee lifter and red foot pedal.
Photos 0 and 1: 'EMEL' badge on the machine arm and a small 'EM 8500' badge on the front of the head; 'EMEL' also on the table edge and the pedal.
Photo 0: a motor hangs under the table with a red OFF and green ON switch box on the table leg.
Photos 0 and 1: a boxed 'EMEL Clutch Motor' sits on the floor beside the table; unclear whether it is part of the sale.
Photos 0 and 1: paint and table top look clean with no visible rust or cracks; scissors, tape measure and bobbin tray on the table.
Nothing shows the machine powered on or sewing; watermark 'Posted on Jiji EKZEE BADMUS'.

identity.kind: industrial straight-stitch sewing machine with table and motor
read_from: photo 1 'EM 8500' badge on front of head

claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show an industrial head on a table with an under-table motor and pedal.
Age cannot be shown by a photo; the clean finish is consistent but does not prove it.
No clip of the motor running or the machine sewing.

risks.risk: Motor, clutch or machine may not run, or may skip stitches or have timing faults.
risks.proof: Clip of the motor switched on and the machine sewing a straight seam on fabric, then the stitched fabric held up close, with the seller's handwritten note in shot.

risks.risk: The boxed clutch motor on the floor may not be included, or may be the replacement for a faulty fitted motor.
risks.proof: Seller's written list of what is included, with a photo of the fitted motor's label.
risks.if_unproven: as machine and table with the fitted motor only

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as bobbin case, bobbins and presser foot.
risks.proof: Close-up of the bobbin area under the bed and the needle plate.

proof_requests: Clip of the machine sewing a straight seam on fabric with the motor running, with a handwritten note showing today's date.
Written list of what is included, especially the boxed clutch motor.
Close-up of the bobbin case area and the motor label.
response.reason: Brand and model are read off the machine (Emel EM 8500 industrial straight-stitch machine on table), so it can be priced at its worst case as not working until a sewing clip is supplied.
